kurz: Flour provides starch for the [[krume|crumb]] and protein for the [[glutenbildung|gluten network]]. How much protein it has decides what it is good for.
bild_im_kopf: Like building material in two kinds: starch is the filling, protein is the frame.
was_passiert: Wheat flour with a lot of protein (Manitoba, bread flour) gives a strong network for bread and pizza. Lower-protein flour suits cakes. Darker flours contain more bran, take up more water and taste stronger. Rye forms hardly any gluten and needs acid.
faustregeln: For bread and pizza, flour with a lot of protein; for cakes, rather little.

rolle.rolle: starch becomes the crumb when baked
